title: Home Assistant frontend: child devices (#53617, #53619, #53638)
source: Three merged changes of 13 and 14 August 2026, applied alone on the commit before the first: child devices in the frontend's device registry data (#53617), the child devices UI (#53619) and a fix to the device tree indicator (#53638).
test_command: ./node_modules/.bin/gulp gen-icons-json build-translations build-locale-data > /tmp/gulp.log 2>&1 && npx vitest run --config test/vitest.config.ts --reporter=junit --outputFile=/out/report.xml
notes:
- Node 24, with the repository's dependencies installed (`node_modules` links to them). There is no internet: nothing can be installed.
- Before running tests, generate what they import once: `./node_modules/.bin/gulp gen-icons-json build-translations build-locale-data`. Then `npx vitest run --config test/vitest.config.ts` (about half a minute), or give it a test file.
- The production build, `IS_TEST=true ./node_modules/.bin/gulp build-app-modern` (about a minute), writes `hass_frontend/`. Home Assistant core serves it when its configuration has `frontend:` with `development_repo:` set to this repository's path.
